fluff.overview: Lyran military budgets translate directly into infantry equipment quality, giving LCAF conventional forces a material edge that compensates for the uneven tactical leadership the social general tradition sometimes produces. Mechanized hover platoons ride into battle aboard hovercraft that provide both speed and the ability to cross water and rough terrain without slowing, making them effective rapid-reaction forces. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable short-range missile launchers, these platoons carry enough anti-armor punch to threaten light vehicles and BattleMechs at close range.
